prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make one original landscape book and article illustration, 3:2 ratio, at least 1536x1024. Human Natural skill, Poetic Natural mode. Subject: the household and the wider social world, for a literary profile of Odia novelist Kanhu Charan Mohanty whose novels consider lives under social and economic pressure. A restrained pen-and-ink drawing with light watercolour, an ordinary shaded domestic doorway seen from inside looking toward a small open courtyard and a farther lane. A simple wooden door partly open, a cotton cloth drying on a practical line, gentle daylight falling across a threshold. One small indistinct passerby beyond the doorway; human scale, no facial detail. This is a conceptual literary illustration, not a film still, not the author's actual home, not a portrait or an identified novel scene. Architecture modest and plausible, no elaborate ornaments, no monuments or costume stereotypes. Emotional intention: a private home belongs to a wider world; quiet possibility, not picturesque poverty. Confident selective hand-drawn linework, off-white paper, muted indigo shadows and small terracotta wash; substantial untouched paper and asymmetrical framing. No tiled mirrored composition, no staged family, no sunlight beams or sepia nostalgia filter, no photorealism, no text, no watermarks. The composition should work both full width in a book and as a central landscape card crop.
caption: Illustration: a household opens onto the wider world.
limitations: Conceptual illustration, not a portrait, historic site, novel scene or film still.
visual_review: Retained: coherent doorway and shadow, ordinary objects, small distant figure, visible hand-drawn medium, no generated lettering. Distinct from adjacent bookmaking, rice-field and page-as-stage illustrations.
